Now the weather for the trip dates.
Three days of lighthouses and fish soup in Examplestad
A slow harbour-town weekend: the main square and a bike ride on day one, the lighthouse at
sunset on day two, and fish soup indoors when the rain arrives.
Start in the main square, where the clock always runs five minutes fast.
Rent a bicycle at the station and explore at your own pace.
A cosy pub by the pier for the first evening.
Most sights are within walking distance of the harbour.
Ride the single tram line from the station to the lighthouse.
Climb the 120 steps to the viewpoint at sunset.
The tram runs every 15 minutes; walk back along the harbour.
Fish soup on a rainy day
Family-run and known for fish soup, the local speciality.
• The tram runs every 15 minutes, so there is no timetable to plan around [3].
• Pack a windproof layer: winters here are windy [10].
• Dates taken as Friday 13 to Sunday 15 November 2026.
. Check prices and opening hours before you go.
